mapper.select: /*master.mdcm.selectMasterMdCmContractSelPopList*/ SELECT A.CONTRACT_NO, MAX(A.CONTRACT_SUBJECT) AS CONTRACT_SUBJECT, MAX(A.CONTRACT_DATE) AS CONTRACT_DATE, MAX(A.CONTRACT_TO_DATE) AS CONTRACT_TO_DATE, COUNT(B.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ, MAX(A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID, MAX(A.ADD_USER_NAME) AS ADD_USER_NAME FROM ICOMCQHD A, ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = upper(#{st_buyer}) AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER(+) AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO(+) AND B.STATUS(+) = 'C' AND A.SAVE_FLAG = 'PC' GROUP BY A.CONTRACT_NO
